blurb: Big Dogs on the River is a family-owned business offering kayak and tubing trips on the Middle Oconee River. Guests paddle through three shoals and are picked up at the take-out point by a shuttle. Equipment, parking, and shuttle service are included in the rate. They also offer group packages and a multi-purpose cabana rental for events.
